mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS declining below 4.0% over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.0% in the labor market signals tight labor conditions, reducing growth expectations and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 5.0% but S&P 500 20d returns remain positive or show no significant decline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS (above 4.0%) and CPIAUCSL (above 98.0) signal recession fears, compressing growth expectations and equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS >4% and CPIAUCSL >98 in recession anticipation regime.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (demand) signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST rise but S&P 5d returns remain negative or insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO (supply) during a late-cycle expansion signals potential demand softening, prompting strategic buying and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline in late-cycle expansion periods fails to correlate with S&P 60d positive returns (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS below 2.0% AND CPIAUCSL below 100.0 (deflationary environment) signals accommodative policy and low inflation, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <2% and CPIAUCSL <100 but S&P 20d returns are negative or insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (employment) and falling UNRATE (wage growth) indicate a strong labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS up and UNRATE down but S&P 5d returns negative or insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS (demand in millions) dropping below 300k signals weakening demand, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS <300k but S&P 60d returns remain positive or show no decline.
